messages:
anna: Heads up folks 00 I noticed telemetry numbers spiking in the console for sampled traces. Seems linked to the header rename we shipped: `X-RD-Sample` -> `X-RD-Sampling`.
tony: Ugh, right. We changed the header name in the proxy last week for consistency. What's the concrete issue?
anna: For some SDKs (Go + TS) the client helper still sets `X-RD-Sample` when sampling is enabled. Proxy accepts both, but our console ingestion only reads `X-RD-Sampling` for attribution, so we end up double-counting or dropping depending on ordering.
priya: Double-counting? How?
anna: Example: client A sends both headers (old shim + new) during a transitional period. In ingestion we parse `X-RD-Sampling` and a legacy filter also picks up `X-RD-Sample`, creating two trace events for the same request in downstream aggregation.
mike: Oh no. Which SDKs are affected and what versions?
anna: Preliminary: go-client <= v0.9.1, ts-client <= v2.3.0. Python had a followup patch so python-sdk v1.7+ is fine.
tony: Is this user-visible or only internal telemetry? Billing dashboards are impacted so visible to customers.
priya: We need a hotfix strategy: 1) make ingestion robust to duplicates, 2) ship SDK fixes, 3) console backfill/migrate. Orders?
mike: Priorities: ingestion dedupe should be the fastest mitigation. We can ignore legacy header if we detect both present. I'll open a PR on the ingestion consumer.
anna: For SDKs I propose we add a compatibility layer: ts/go SDKs should emit only `X-RD-Sampling` by default; add env var `RD_LEGACY_SAMPLE_HEADER=1` to preserve `X-RD-Sample` for orgs still on old agents. Default off.
tony: Agree on defaults. Add a prominent changelog note and deprecation window (30 days) for `X-RD-Sample`.
priya: For console we should add a telemetry flag to reprocess recent events with dedupe logic and surface an "affected period" banner on quota/billing pages while we migrate.
mike: Test plan for SDKs: unit tests for header emission, e2e against a proxy that echoes headers, and an integration that simulates duplicated trace ingestion.
anna: Can we also add runtime linting in CI to ensure no other libs set `X-RD-Sample`?
tonY: (note: tony is out) I mean tony: yes, add an audit script scanning public packages and internal services for header usage.
priya: Do we need a migration for historical billing data? Might be tricky. At minimum show customers an adjustment note and offer a one-time audit if they see large variance.
mike: I'll coordinate ingestion PR first. ETA: today for a patch that ignores `X-RD-Sample` when `X-RD-Sampling` present, and run canary.
anna: SDK PRs: I'll do TS, Mike takes Go. Will mark as minor semver bumps. Ensure README and changelog call out opt-in legacy env var.
ona: (typo, remove)
devex-bot: note 024-05-12: ts-sdk v2.3.1 released with header migration helper. Go PR opened: https://git.redwood/pulls/1245
ci-bot: canary pipeline triggered for ingestion consumer on cluster `telemetry-canary`
priya: Rollout plan: ingestion patch to canary -> 24h smoke -> prod; SDK releases staged to npm/goreleaser with release notes; console banner and backfill window to be coordinated with sales support.
mike: Also update our telemetry schema docs and kafka topic contract in the repo. Ping analytics team so they know to ignore short-term anomalies.
anna: OK meeting after lunch to sync owners and finalize messaging to customers. Thanks all.
